summary: End-to-end verified the reworked Competitor Intelligence 5-stage guided cycle (/competitor-intel) for testpro@test.com (Enterprise owner). Login → CI page → stepper renders all 5 steps → Plan (add objective, toggle Pricing focus chip, add question, notes, Save) → Gather (my-pricing dialog opens, add-competitor dialog opens with blank-submit validation, competitors-list rendered) → Analyze (benchmark-strip visible, analysis-result loaded with summary + competitor-swot card, no re-run needed since already cached) → Share (copy report clicked, teams selected, log-share added entry to share-history) → Act (7 actions listed, cycled first action status, added TEST_manual action, deleted it successfully). Persistence verified after reload: 3 objectives, 2 questions, notes preserved. Backend endpoints were already curl-verified by main agent; frontend wiring for all new endpoints (plan, analyze, actions, actions/generate, shares, report) works correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Only 1 competitor-swot card rendered even though the org has 2 competitors (Clari + Oliv ai). Likely because the cached analysis returned by GET /api/competitors/analysis was produced when only 1 competitor existed. A fresh POST /api/competitors/analyze re-run should include both. Not blocking — analysis-result, summary, patterns, opps/threats all render.

action_items: Optional: after adding a new competitor, invalidate the cached analysis (or prompt user to re-run) so Stage 3 SWOT reflects all current competitors. Currently the UI shows the previously-cached analysis with fewer competitors.
critical_code_review_comments: CompetitorIntel.js is a large single-file page (~740 lines). Consider extracting each stage (PlanStage/GatherStage/AnalyzeStage/ShareStage/ActStage) into its own component for maintainability.

The plan-notes textarea appears to have received unusually long content (1337 chars) during test — because the automation dumped a JSHandle repr into it. Not an app bug; just noting the textarea has no client-side max length. Consider a reasonable maxLength (e.g. 5000).

rca of the issue: SWOT card mismatch RCA: GET /api/competitors/analysis returns the last saved analysis document. If a competitor was added after the last analyze run, the cached document won't include it. Mitigation: either auto-invalidate cached analysis when the competitors set changes, or display a 'stale — re-run' hint in the UI when analysis.competitors_count != current competitors.length.
